title: Persistency Decision Table: Surrender Termination Dividend of Whole Life Insurance After Returned Premium Payments
content:
On the full surrender of an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy, the surrender termination dividend is cut for an interrupted premium record, judged by the premium payments returned unpaid on the policy ledger and dated within the 24 calendar months before the day the surrender is processed.

| Returned premium payments in the window | Termination dividend paid |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 50% (0.5) of its amount |
| Exactly one | 80% (0.8) of its amount |
| None | In full |

The amount paid is rounded half up to the cent and counts toward the gross cash value; the share is taken of the unrounded termination dividend.

**Window.** A return dated later than the same day of the month twenty-four months before the processing day is inside; one dated on that day or earlier is outside.

**Cases (hypothetical, surrender processed July 14, 2025, termination dividend before the cut 1200.00).**

| Returns dated | In the window | Paid |
|---|---|---|
| September 3, 2023 and March 3, 2025 | 2 | 600.00 |
| July 14, 2023 and March 3, 2025 | 1 (the first is exactly twenty-four months earlier) | 960.00 |
| None since 2021 | 0 | 1200.00 |
